cases.name: j and k walk the rows that take focus, in visual order
k with nothing focused starts from the bottom
removing the focused row moves focus to the next row, else the previous
a refetch never moves focus, though its row moves
a refetch that drops the focused row moves focus to the next row
j opens the next thread; acting on the open one returns to the list where its row was; undo brings it back
j to a todo closes the open thread
a bundle opens, the keyboard pages it in, and focus follows to the first new row
a page that brings nothing new gives focus back to the row it left
an open bundle shows five until j asks past them
a thread swiped to past an open bundle's first five keeps them all shown once it closes
Show more shows every loaded thread of the open bundle
focus leaving an open bundle closes it, by keys or a pointer
a refetch dropping the open bundle's last shown thread, while Gmail has more, waits on its header for the next page
an empty open bundle closes once Gmail has no more
Done on an open bundle's last shown threads, while Gmail has more, waits on its header and moves to the first new row
undo after acting on a selection restores the rows and focus
a failed write brings its rows back without moving focus
selection only holds rows that exist
a thread shows once, in one place
a thread opened from outside the list waits for its row
a thread opened from a notification opens the bundle it is in
Escape steps back one level at a time
an action key acts on the open thread, else the selection, else the focused row
the scroll anchor moves to the next row when its row goes
another view drops focus, the open thread and bundle, selection and removals
new mail at the top of a loading bundle doesn't take focus from the page
a page that brings nothing to show while Gmail has more gives focus back and j asks again
undoing Done on a closed bundle brings focus back to its header
a row waited for that comes back inside a closed bundle is focused at the bundle
a tap outside an open bundle closes it rather than acting
j on an empty open bundle whose page is on its way waits without asking again
Escape and a click away close only the top layer: the menu, then the open thread, then the open bundle
with a thread open in a bundle, a tap outside the bundle closes the thread, then a second one the bundle
a menu closing names itself, so a late close of another menu changes nothing

Done on an open bundle's last thread when Gmail has no more stays in the bundle on the thread before it; Done on its only thread moves focus past it and closes the bundle; undo reopens nothing but focuses the thread at its header
Done on the open thread at the end of an open bundle stays in the bundle on the thread before it
Done on an open bundle's fifth shown thread moves focus to the sixth, which shows in its place
Done on the shown threads of an open bundle at the end of the list, while Gmail has more, waits on its header for the next page
a new todo takes focus and scrolls into view, at once when listed or once a layout lists it
the threads either side of the open one: across sections, past todos and bundles, and inside an open bundle only its own
the thread open in a bundle reaches every loaded thread past the five shown, and says how many follow it
a bundle shows its todos among its threads, in its order; focus walks them and stays in the bundle when one goes
Done all on a closed bundle takes its todos with its threads, and undo brings them back
a bundle of todos alone opens, and its preview counts todos
j past an open bundle's last todo pages it in, and focus goes to the new threads that sort above the todo
